raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions contains 26 re-delivered rows with record_version=2 that duplicate txn_ids already present at version 1, and silver_transactions keeps every version instead of the latest one per txn_id. The fix is to keep only the highest record_version per txn_id (ingest_ts as tiebreaker) before applying the POSTED filter, so a superseding REVERSED version is not left behind as POSTED.","decision": "fix","confidence": 0.6,"pre_sql": [],"step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
